newsitem.title: USA: UOL Publishing files for IPO.
newsitem.headline: UOL Publishing files for IPO.

text.p: UOL Publishing Inc, formerly known as University Online Inc, said on Tuesday it has filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an initial public offering of up to 1,334,000 shares of common stock.
In addition, the company said it has granted the underwriters an over-allotment option of an additional 200,100 voting shares.
Friedman, Billings, Ramsey & Co Inc is managing the offering.

The company said it will use the proceeds to repay debt, and for general corporate purposes, including working capital. They may also be used to acquire or invest in businesses, products or complementary technologies, the company said.
UOL Publishing publishes interactive, on-demand, web-based courseware for the academic and corporate education markets.
